facts.source_quote: NEW: Prednisone 40 mg by mouth once daily with breakfast for 5 days, then stop. Last dose 10/18/2026.
facts.detail: Start taking Prednisone 40 mg daily with breakfast for 5 days, then stop on 10/18/2026.

facts.source_quote: NEW: Tiotropium 2 puffs inhaled once daily.
CHANGED: Albuterol inhaler 2 puffs every 4 hours as needed for shortness of breath (was every 6 hours).
facts.detail: Change Albuterol inhaler from every 6 hours to every 4 hours as needed for shortness of breath.

facts.source_quote: STOP: Ipratropium inhaler - do not use together with tiotropium.
facts.detail: Do not use Ipratropium inhaler together with Tiotropium.

facts.source_quote: Do not smoke. Smoking cessation clinic referral sent.
facts.detail: Do not smoke. Refer to smoking cessation clinic.

facts.source_quote: Return precautions: Call 911 for severe shortness of breath, blue lips, or confusion. Call your doctor if you need albuterol more than every 4 hours or have fever above 38.5 C.
facts.detail: Call 911 if you have severe shortness of breath, blue lips, or confusion. Call your doctor if you need albuterol more than every 4 hours or have a fever above 38.5 C.

facts.source_quote: Follow-up: Pulmonary clinic with [CLINICIAN_1] on 10/30/2026. Pulmonary rehabilitation intake on 11/04/2026.
facts.detail: Follow up with the pulmonary clinic on 10/30/2026 and for pulmonary rehabilitation intake on 11/04/2026.

sentences.text: You will take Prednisone 40 mg once daily with breakfast for 5 days, then stop on 10/18/2026. (F1, F5)
You will start taking Tiotropium 2 puffs once daily. (F2, F5)
You will change Albuterol inhaler to 2 puffs every 4 hours as needed for shortness of breath. (F3, F5)
Call 911 if you have severe shortness of breath, blue lips, or confusion. Call your doctor if you need albuterol more than every 4 hours or have a fever above 38.5 C. (F4, F6)
Follow up with the pulmonary clinic on 10/30/2026 and for pulmonary rehabilitation intake on 11/04/2026. (F5, F7)

items.text: Vous prendrez la Prednisone à 40 mg une fois par jour le matin pendant 5 jours, puis arrêter le 18 octobre 2026. (F1, F5)
Vous commencerez à prendre la Tiotropium à 2 puffs une fois par jour. (F2, F5)
Vous changerez l'insuline Albuterol à 2 puffs toutes les 4 heures selon les besoins pour les difficultés respiratoires. (F3, F5)

Appelez l'urgence si vous avez une difficultés respiratoire sévère, des lèvres bleues ou de la confusion. Appelez votre médecin si vous avez besoin d'Albuterol plus souvent toutes les 4 heures ou si vous avez une température supérieure à 38,5°C. (F4, F6)
Suivez votre rendez-vous chez le pulmonologue le 30 octobre 2026 et pour l'entrée dans le programme de réhabilitation le 4 novembre 2026. (F5, F7)
You will take Prednisone at 40 mg once a day in the morning for 5 days, then stop on October 18, 2026. (F1, F5)
You will start taking Tiotropium at 2 puffs once a day. (F2, F5)
You will change Albuterol insulin to 2 puffs every 4 hours as needed for respiratory difficulties. (F3, F5)

Call the emergency room if you have severe respiratory difficulties, blue lips, or confusion. Call your doctor if you need Albuterol more often every 4 hours or if your temperature is higher than 38.5°C. (F4, F6)
Follow up with your pulmonologist on October 30, 2026, and for entry into the rehabilitation program on November 4, 2026. (F5, F7)
